source_refs.note: Endotherms: a main subheading of 13.3.1 Types of Animals on the basis of Heat Source, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 7-8.

blocks.text: Endotherms apne jism ki zyada tar hararat andar ke metabolism se khud paida karte hain. Yeh apne jism ka darja-e-hararat kafi had tak ek jaisa rakhte hain, jo aksar mahol se zyada hota hai. Birds aur mammals endotherms hain. Thand barhne par yeh kaampte (shiver karte) hain (muscles ka sukarna) ya hararat ke liye brown adipose tissue (bhoori charbi) jalate hain. Zyada tar endotherms mein hararat rokne ke liye insulation hoti hai, jaise baal, par (feathers) ya charbi.

blocks.prompt: Jism ki hararat ke maakhaz ki bunyad par janwaron ki darja-bandi kijiye.
blocks.explanation: Ectotherms mahol se hararat lete aur rawayye se qaboo karte (machhliyan, amphibians, reptiles, zyada tar invertebrates); endotherms metabolism se hararat banate aur insulation se rakhte (parinde, mammals).

items: Ectotherms: hararat bahar se; metabolism kam; dhoop sekna, saya dhoondna jaisa rawayya; machhliyan, amphibians, reptiles, zyada tar invertebrates.
Endotherms: hararat andar ke metabolism se; mustaqil darja-e-hararat; kaampna, brown adipose tissue, insulation; birds aur mammals.
